defs.def: the opinion that people have about what sb/sth is like, based on what has happened in the past 名誉；名声

ex.s: Even though Britain has a reputation for less-than-impressive cuisine, it is producing more top class chefs who appear frequently on our television screens and whose recipe books frequently top the best seller lists.
ex.t: 尽管英国以平庸的烹饪闻名，但它正在培养出更多一流厨师，他们频繁出现在电视屏幕上，其食谱书也经常登上畅销榜榜首。
它值得享有很高的声誉。

ex.s: Here was this challenging student who had a reputation for single-mindedness and good grades—the exact opposite of me.
ex.t: 这位极具挑战性的学生以专心和好成绩闻名——与我截然相反。

ex.s: an improved reputation of the hospital
The artist’s reputation had made him proud.
ex.t: 这位艺术家的名声让他变得骄傲。

ex.s: To improve his reputation as a biologist.
ex.t: 为了提升他作为生物学家的声誉。

ex.s: Does Kilimanjaro   60   its reputation as a crowded mountain with lines of tourists ruining the atmosphere of peace？I found the opposite to be true.
ex.t: 乞力马扎罗山___60___它作为一座拥挤、游客排成长队破坏宁静氛围的山之名声了吗？我发现事实恰恰相反。

ex.s: To earn himself a good reputation.
ex.t: 为了给自己赢得好名声。

ex.s: These were attempts to damage Carson’s reputation and stop her work from influencing public policy, but she remained determined to stand by her research.
ex.t: 反复地/再次地，再次地/多次尝试时也一直失败。

ex.s: While painters as early as Da Vinci had used oil, this technique reached its height with Rembrandt (1606–1669), who gained a reputation as a master of shadow and light.
ex.t: 在画家早在达芬奇使用过石油的时候，这种技术就达到了与伦勃朗(1606–1669)的高度，伦勃朗获得了影光大师的声誉。

ex.s: However, its reputation as a top destination has had negative effects on the river’s water quality.
ex.t: 然而，它作为顶级旅游目的地的声誉对河流水质产生了负面影响。

ex.s: Reevestarred infourSupermanfilmsfrom1978to 1987.Herealised that his roles in these films had given him the opportunityto be a real-life superman, and he soon gained a reputation for raising 15 awareness for good causes.
ex.t: 里夫在1978年至1987年间主演了四部超人电影。他意识到他在这些电影中的角色给了他成为现实生活中超人的机会，他很快就因提高对公益事业的______意识而名声大噪。

ex.s: He has a reputation for constantly encountering awkward situations, which greatly amuses audiences of all nationalities and funny acts that rely purely on body language that is universal.
ex.t: 他以经常陷入尴尬处境而闻名，这极大地逗乐了各国观众，也以纯粹依靠通用肢体语言的滑稽表演著称。
